scripts-descriptions.lint:phpstan:level5: Non-blocking PHPStan level-5 progress check for the whole theme
scripts-descriptions.test:all: Unit and integration tests in order (stops at the first failing suite; needs the integration setup). The E2E suite is long and is run separately with test:e2e
scripts-descriptions.test:integration: Integration tests (PHPUnit on a real WordPress, dedicated database)
scripts-descriptions.test:e2e: Functional tests (Playwright on the E2E site; needs DLI_E2E_SITE_PATH). Extra options after --
scripts-descriptions.test:e2e:headed: Functional tests with a visible browser
scripts-descriptions.test:e2e:ui: Functional tests in Playwright UI mode
